scope: Explicit answers to questions 1-6, 8 and 9. No new ontology class, object property, graph identity policy, source completeness claim or semantic fingerprint is admitted. Question 7 requires explanation and is not accepted.

accepted.meaning: Compare PAs by occupied bases and out count immediately before the batter consequence, not at PA start. In the steal-then-single example, use second base for the comparison cohort. Independent progress remains excluded from batter credit.

Fixed additive marginal values: first to second = 1/3, second to third = 1/2, third to home = 1. First to third = 5/6 independent of source-row segmentation. These are analytical advancement points, not measured Speed.
Report positive independent advancement, accepted damage magnitude, and net contribution = advancement minus damage together. Preserve all three components.

Review-dependence denominator includes all decisions eligible for review in the declared population, including decisions never reviewed. Exact outcome categories, operative identity and season-specific eligibility still require evidence and review.
Report traditional replay and ball/strike challenges separately; do not pool their review-dependence results.

A source's explicit supported safe association with a Base at the relevant boundary may supply the metric end state even if exact physical location and persistence duration are unknown. This does not assert physical location or a stasis. The supported authoritative graph representation remains to be reviewed.

Ordinary trajectory scoring may use a supported final operative runner outcome when the original pre-review call is unavailable. Review-dependent calculations remain unavailable where required evidence is missing. This does not make every final source label a proven operative outcome.

Keep actual consequence-contributor attribution separate from official statistical PA attribution in mid-turn substitutions. Do not transfer the whole PA or earlier actions merely because a replacement finishes the turn. Exact participant/action links remain evidence requirements.

unresolved.proposal: Whether an independently reconciled complete history, matching participant/segment boundaries, and accounted-for movements, outcomes, substitutions and inning boundaries can establish a continuous personal trajectory. Matching IDs or adjacent records alone remain insufficient.

unchanged: No new object properties, including index predicates
No fabricated source or RDF completeness
No new ontology terms or identity policy
Error/FC progress exclusion and interference deferral
Accepted terminal-out policy; no new credit for an intermediate advance in a path ending out
